name: solo-loop
description: Turn long-horizon goals into unattended, resumable, rate-limit-resilient autonomous loops with disk-backed state and isolated subtasks.

displayDescription.en: Decomposes a long-horizon goal into a task tree and drives it unattended: state on disk for resume-after-crash, isolated subtasks so context never explodes, automatic backoff and model fallback under rate limits.
displayDescription.zh: 把长期目标拆成任务树自动推进：状态落盘可续跑，子任务隔离执行不爆上下文，遇限流自动退避。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把「整理日语N2语法成Anki卡组」跑成一个无人值守的长循环任务
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run 'build an Anki deck for JLPT N2 grammar' as an unattended long-horizon loop
